[CGMZ] Achievements
By: Casper Gaming
Last Update: April 19, 2026
Latest Version: 1.9.1
​
Adds an achievements system including achievement points, secret achievements, difficulty, and more. Achievements offer automatic tracking as well as manual unlocking. Achievements can also have rewards such as items or gold, or even switches/variables. This plugin works well with CGMZ Toast Manager for pop ups when an achievement is earned. This plugin also allows for achievements based off of CGMZ Encyclopedia and Bestiary completion percentage.
Add an achievement system with automatic tracking
Secret achievements with different descriptions for before/after earn
Achievement Points (optional)
Rewards can include items, switches, variables, and more
Criteria can include items, switches, variables, currency, and more
Spoiler:
Screenshots
An achievement that has been earned
A secret achievement
An achievement with automatic tracking and a gauge progress tracker
An achievement with a lot of criteria/rewards
Achievement window can scroll if needed to show additional information
Import into plugin manager and enable the plugin. Some customization options available. Further instructions in plugin.
Online documentation can be found on my
website
.
User documentation can be found on the
Casper Gaming Wiki
.
Plugin (along with all my other plugins) can be found here:
https://www.caspergaming.com/plugins/cgmz/achievements/
Requires CGMZ Core plugin:
https://www.caspergaming.com/plugins/cgmz/core/
To easily add this plugin to the menu, use my Menu Command Window:
https://www.caspergaming.com/plugins/cgmz/menucommandwindow/
To enable pop up messages when the user earns an achievement, use my Toast Manager:
https://www.caspergaming.com/plugins/cgmz/toastmanager/
This plugin also supports achievements for completion percentages in my Encyclopedia and Bestiary:
https://www.caspergaming.com/plugins/cgmz/encyclopedia/
This plugin also supports achievements for my Profession system:
https://www.caspergaming.com/plugins/cgmz/professions/

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all,
This plugin has been updated to version 1.3.0 today!
This update modernizes control over the display window, so now you can reorder or disable any line in the display window like most of my other plugins  . Other small things were updated as well, including a parameter to show separate text for Points in the total and display window, a parameter to display the total points possible in the total window, and a param to display the total achievements possible in the total window. For some reason, when I initially made this plugin, I hard-coded some English words to describe progress bars like for criterias like "Number of Saves". Now every piece of text should be controlled by text parameters, especially important for games not made in English!
Version 1.3.0:
- Added ability to choose which order & info to display for achievements
- Added param for Points text in total window (separate from Display window)
- Added param to display total achievements possible in total window

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, CGMZ Achievements was updated today
!
This update adds the ability to run a common event as a reward, which is a much-requested feature to get around some of the limitations of the other reward types. Now you can event your rewards and provide rewards with no limit.
The second major feature of this plugin is the ability to mark an achievement as failed. Failed achievements can still be manually completed, but will no longer automatically track their completion as there is an assumption that a failed achievement is no longer able to be earned. You can mark an achievement as failed by using the new plugin command. Failed achievements have some new parameters for how they are displayed in the achievement scene as well.
Lastly, one minor new feature which will be coming to all of my plugins is the ability to "hide" the empty space where Touch UI would be if the player has Touch UI turned off (or if you permanently disabled Touch UI as the dev). This is a toggle parameter that needs to be turned ON because some third-party plugins may add their own things to that space.
Version 1.5.0
- Added common event as reward for achievement
- Added ability to mark an achievement as failed via Plugin Command
- Added some display window options for failed achievements
- Added option to fill space where touch UI buttons would be

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.6.0!
The main feature in this update is the custom rewards. You can now display custom lines of text in the rewards section. This can be helpful to describe some of the more manual rewards such as those awarded by common events. Speaking of common event rewards, this update fixes a bug where the achievement would not recognize it had rewards if the only reward was a common event.
This update also added some more customization features. You can now change each window's windowskin, padding, background opacity, and tone. You can also change the header line gradient colors. This plugin now supports text codes everywhere you have text, including the toast window. This means that you now need to place [CGMZ] Achievements after [CGMZ] Toast Manager in your Plugin Manager. Achievements should no longer default to the Applause sound effect, instead defaulting to no sound effect when earned.
This update includes a major refactor of the code to move a lot of unnecessary things out of save data. This means you will now be able to change achievement rewards, requirements, difficulty, and automatic parameters and have changes made reflected in saved games. This should cut down on save file sizes quite significantly as well.
Note:
The Scene Background parameter was changed, and it now supports all image folders instead of forcing your background to be in the pictures folder.
Due to this change, you will need to reset this parameter when updating to this version.

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.7.0!
This update adds quite a lot of new customization options. You can now choose to have the totals window display vertically (the only option previously), horizontally, or not at all. You can also change the list window's width as well as if it displays on the right or the left of the scene. By moving the various windows around, you should be able to make the scene much more custom looking.
This update also allows you to change what is in the windows. You can now display the total earned out of total possible achievements in the category window. You can also show the achievement points in the list window, and add in a background image for each list item. See the below image for how these changes can look in one possible configuration:
There were also some quality of life changes added with this update. You can now choose the order reward types and criteria types display in via the standard drag and drop selectable parameter type I use for all of my plugins.
A plugin command was added to check the status of an achievement, for use in your events. Now you can easily know if an achievement is still in progress, earned, or failed.
You can now change the total window separator text, variable operator parameters are now select type instead of text, and this plugin no longer requires [CGMZ] Toast Manager to be above it in the Plugin Manager.
Version 1.7.0
Added plugin command to check achievement status
Added option to show category earned/total in category window
Added control over reward and requirement display order
Added total window display style
Added list window width parameter
Added list window background image
Added list window on right option
Added total window separator text param
Variable Operator is now select parameter type
Order no longer matters with [CGMZ] Toast Manager

Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.8.0!

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.8.2!
This version converted the [CGMZ] Toast Manager integration to use the new toast preset system. Previously, you used to need to set up all of your toast parameters via this plugin. There is now a global preset which acts as a fall back, and a specific per-achievement preset you can use. This lets you use different achievement toasts for each achievement.
This update also added a custom space line item to your display window display parameters, so you can now add a custom amount of blank vertical space between line items. This has been added for display info, rewards, and criteria.
This update changed the achievement description parameter type from note to multiline_string. This reduces the amount of JSON parsing the plugin has to do, which is a common failure point for new users to ask about. This should make the plugin easier for new users to pick up and use without seeing warnings in the console. However, it does mean that existing users will need to set up your description parameters and any Change Description plugin commands you may have used again.
Version 1.8.2
Added custom space display line item
[CGMZ] Toast Manager integration converted to preset
Achievement description type converted from note to multiline_string

Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.9.0!
This version adds global achievements. You can now make it so that if one save file earns an achievement, all save files and new game starts will automatically earn that achievement the next time they are loaded or a new game is started.
To make an achievement global, set its new Global flag to true in the achievement setup parameters.
Global achievements go by earn status, not progress. This means if you have an achievement to earn 1,000 gold, you cannot earn this achievement by obtaining 100 gold on 10 separate save files. However, if you set it to be global and any one save file earns the 1,000 gold, all saves files will automatically unlock the achievement and obtain any rewards it had.
Version 1.9.0
Added global achievements
